title: Fixed an uncaught error thrown when the grid was destroyed from a hook of a cell edit's save: `beforeChange`, `afterSetDataAtCell`, `afterSetDataAtRowProp`, `beforeChangeRender`, `afterRender`, or `afterChange` of `setDataAtCell()` or `setDataAtRowProp()`, or a hook of an editor saved with Enter, Tab, an arrow key, or a click on another cell.
